action_args.comment_content: As the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA), we would like to clarify that Halcourt Bank is subject to the full scope of Swiss financial regulations and supervision by FINMA. While innovation is encouraged, it must not compromise compliance with regulatory standards. FINMA ensures that all supervised entities, including Halcourt Bank, adhere to the highest levels of transparency, accountability, and consumer protection. Any claims of exemption from standard banking regulations are incorrect and do not reflect the rigorous oversight that FINMA exercises.
